title: Normalized uncurrying of varying coefficient modules
statement: Let (C,J) be a site and B an inverse sequence of commutative ring sheaves. Form the ring presheaf R on the opposite of the product of the natural-number category and C by uncurrying B after forgetting commutativity. The full category of R-module presheaves whose vertical slices are sheaves is equivalent to StrictRingSystem B. The equivalence fixes the section modules, vertical restriction maps, all horizontal transition maps and components of morphisms, up to heterogeneous equality. The same conclusion holds for a coefficient presheaf equal to R.

source.place: Coefficient-tower lemma, clauses (1)--(3); Bhatt--Scholze Definition 3.5.3; Stacks 06YS and 06XN

proof.text: Restrict a product module to each vertical slice. Scalar restriction along the equality of the sliced ring maps gives the existing ringed-site module. Horizontal restrictions supply the strict transitions; product functoriality proves their identity and composition laws.

source.place: Coefficient-tower lemma, clauses (1)--(3); Bhatt--Scholze Definition 3.5.3; Stacks 06YS and 06XN

proof.text: Conversely use the section module of each level. A product arrow acts by its horizontal transition followed by the vertical restriction. Transition naturality and strict composition prove the module presheaf laws. The vertical sheaf condition follows from the existing level sheaves.

source.place: Coefficient-tower lemma, clauses (1)--(3); Bhatt--Scholze Definition 3.5.3; Stacks 06YS and 06XN

proof.text: The two composites have identity maps on sections. These give natural unit and counit isomorphisms with the triangle identity. The construction fixes all four displayed normalizations; transport along equality of the ring presheaf proves the stated version.
